cards.name: Roaring Knight
cards.effect_raw: {{KW:DARKSPAWN}}. {{KW:MAGIC}}: Deal 12 {{DMG}} to all enemies. Add a {{CARD:936|1}} to the enemy deck (except the top) for every 10 {{DMG}} not dealt.
cards.effect_readable: Darkspawn. Magic: Deal 12 DMG to all enemies. Add a Black Knife [#936] to the enemy deck (except the top) for every 10 DMG not dealt.

cards.name: Strange Machine
cards.effect_raw: This takes 1 less {{DMG}} for each enemy slot enchantment. {{KW:MAGIC}}: Enchant enemy slots with a {{ENCHANT:GREEN_TILE||override=Green}}, {{ENCHANT:YELLOW_TILE||override=Yellow}}, {{ENCHANT:PURPLE_TILE||override=Purple}}, and {{ENCHANT:ORANGE_TILE|1}}.
cards.effect_readable: This takes 1 less DMG for each enemy slot enchantment. Magic: Enchant enemy slots with a Green, Yellow, Purple, and Orange Tile.

cards.name: Jogboy Papyrus
cards.effect_readable: Magic: Enchant all enemy slots with Blue Bones.

cards.name: Wall of Fire
cards.effect_raw: {{KW:MAGIC}}: Enchant all empty and unenchanted enemy slots with {{ENCHANT:THE_FLAME|2}}.
cards.effect_readable: Magic: Enchant all empty and unenchanted enemy slots with The Flame.

cards.name: Fire-E
cards.effect_raw: {{KW:MAGIC}}: Enchant an ally board slot with {{ENCHANT:INCINERATOR|1}}.
cards.effect_readable: Magic: Enchant an ally board slot with Incinerator.

cards.name: Arcade Mew Mew
cards.effect_raw: {{KW:MAGIC}}: Halve the stats of the non-{{RARITY:DETERMINATION}} monster in front of this and summon an exact copy of it.
cards.effect_readable: Magic: Halve the stats of the non-DT monster in front of this and summon an exact copy of it.

cards.name: Tall Bloxer
cards.effect_raw: {{KW:MAGIC}}: Summon 3 random non-{{RARITY:TOKEN}} monsters costing 3 or less {{GOLD}} from your dustpile.
cards.effect_readable: Magic: Summon 3 random non-TOKEN monsters costing 3 or less GOLD from your dustpile.

cards.name: Blackjack
cards.effect_raw: {{KW:DELAY}}: Add a {{CARD:947|1}} to the top 6 cards of your deck. If a monster died with exactly 0 {{HP}} remaining this turn, add it to your hand instead.
cards.effect_readable: Delay: Add a Wild Revolver [#947] to the top 6 cards of your deck. If a monster died with exactly 0 HP remaining this turn, add it to your hand instead.

cards.name: Toriel
cards.effect_raw: {{KW:MAGIC}}: Set an enemy monster's {{ATK}} to 1 and gain {{HP}} equal to the amount of {{ATK}} decreased.
cards.effect_readable: Magic: Set an enemy monster's ATK to 1 and gain HP equal to the amount of ATK decreased.
